visualCharacteristics.purpose: Vertical list of teasers linking to detail pages (related articles, press kits): image, date and category, linked H3 title, optional description
visualCharacteristics.layout: one item per row; image left (~1/3) and text right from 600px, stacked on mobile
visualCharacteristics.image: 16:9 teaser image, linked to the title target
visualCharacteristics.extras: meta line 'date · category' above the title

contentPattern.structure: one row per list item. cell 1: image (+ alt); cell 2: richtext with meta paragraph ('03/02/2026 · Models'), heading (h3) linked to the detail page, optional description paragraph. Every part optional.

instances.section: You might also be interested in

reuseGuidance: Use for dynamic lists of detail-page teasers (articles, press kits) with date/category meta; for grid tiles use a cards grid variant.
